name: goo
title: Goo Orb
description: A glossy green liquid ball whose surface bulges and ripples like wet goo, centred on black.
useWhen: A playful, juicy hero object: a candy, slime, energy or potion moment.
An organic counterpoint to flat UI in a title or product card.
avoidWhen: You want a clean precise sphere: use plastic.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Size
variables.description: Diameter of the orb as a share of the shorter side of the frame.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Bulge
variables.description: How strongly the outline swells and sinks.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it if edges look soft.
